rule: the door and the force pass at 2 n^3 waters on an n^3 body-centred lattice at the state point's density. A box is available to this campaign only if its door admits it AND a counted arm at it fits the price ceiling; both halves are measured here.
door_refusal: the image rule refuses the cell: REFUSED: wrapping this box needs the force law's reach (14.0000 bohr) at or under half its shortest edge (11.0976 bohr); it is over by 2.9024 bohr. Widen the box, shorten the reach, or stay unwrapped.
